\documentclass[tikz,border=2pt]{standalone}
\usetikzlibrary{datavisualization.formats.functions}
\begin{document}
\tikz \datavisualization[
  scientific axes=clean,visualize as smooth line/.list={a,b,c,d,e,f},
  style sheet=vary thickness and dashing,data/format=function]
data[set=a] { var x : interval [0:6] samples 3; func y = .12*\value x; }
data[set=b] { var x : interval [0:6] samples 3; func y = .12*\value x + .35; }
data[set=c] { var x : interval [0:6] samples 3; func y = .12*\value x + .7; }
data[set=d] { var x : interval [0:6] samples 3; func y = .12*\value x + 1.05; }
data[set=e] { var x : interval [0:6] samples 3; func y = .12*\value x + 1.4; }
data[set=f] { var x : interval [0:6] samples 3; func y = .12*\value x + 1.75; };
\end{document}
